post:
AI won't replace you this year. A colleague who uses it better might.

So here are 8 free guides to make sure that colleague is you (40 minutes in total, bookmark this):

→ LEVEL 1 - Get the basics right.

Brief Claude like a new colleague (4 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/guides/brief-claude-like-a-colleague/
Skill, project, instructions or connector? (4 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/guides/skill-or-something-else/
Claude skills, from zero (5 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/guides/claude-skills-from-zero/

→ LEVEL 2 - Use it on real work.

Ask Claude about your data (5 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/guides/ask-claude-about-your-data/
Ten skills worth writing (6 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/p/ten-skills-worth-writing/
Make your first skill (7 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/p/make-your-first-skill/

→ LEVEL 3 - Do it properly.

The one line Claude reads (3 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/p/skill-description/
Check a skill before you trust it (6 min): https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/p/check-a-skill-before-you-trust-it/

Not sure where to begin? Here they are in reading order: https://mojeedabisiga.com/learn/start/

A guide you save and never try is just a bookmark.
Pick one. Open Claude. Do the task it teaches, today.

I write these for one reason: to make data & AI easy for everyone. No paywall on the guides, no catch.

♻️ Repost this for the one person on your team who still says "I'll learn AI later".
